Top 10 Countries by Porn Consumption

🇺🇸 United States — The world’s largest consumer with over 3 billion visits per month.

🇮🇱 Israel — Ranks near the top globally with estimated 800M+ monthly visits relative to population.

🇮🇳India - India has massive potential (bans + VPNs drive hidden traffic); India may be the leader of this list.

🇧🇷 Brazil — One of the top global consumers with around 500M monthly visits.

🇫🇷 France — Consistently ranks high in Europe with about 469M monthly visits.

🇵🇭 Philippines — Extremely high mobile usage drives roughly 453M monthly visits.

🇯🇵 Japan — Maintains strong global presence with around 396M monthly visits.

🇨🇦 Canada — Home to major platforms, generating about 329M monthly visits.

🇲🇽 Mexico — Rapid growth places it near 322M monthly visits.

🇬🇧 United Kingdom — Regularly ranks top 10–12 worldwide with around 268M monthly visits.

Not a single Muslim country on this list.
